summary: Design brief generator: random fake-client briefs for logo, web, graphic, illustration, UI, UX and writing practice.

Nine generator categories, 200+ professionally written briefs, a daily brief, community feedback on your work, exercises and guides; Pro starts at $5 per month for longer pro briefs, all written briefs and dark mode.
